À quinze ans, Harry entre en cinquième année à Poudlard, mais il n'a jamais été si anxieux. L'adolescence, la perspective des examens et ces étranges cauchemars... Car Celui-Dont-On-Ne-Doit-Pas-Prononcer- Le-Nom est de retour. Le ministère de la Magie semble ne pas prendre cette menace au sérieux, contrairement à Dumbledore. La résistance s'organise alors autour de Harry qui va devoir compter sur le courage et la fidélité de ses amis de toujours... D'une inventivité et d'une virtuosité rares, découvrez le cinquième tome de cette saga que son auteur a su hisser au rang de véritable phénomène littéraire.Thème principal composé par James Hannigan
data.name: Harry Potter et l’Ordre du Phénix

data.description:
Author(s): J.K. Rowling
Narrator(s): Bernard Giraudeau

Le jour de ses onze ans, Harry Potter, un orphelin élevé par un oncle et une tante qui le détestent, voit son existence bouleversée. Un géant vient le chercher pour l'emmener à Poudlard, une école de sorcellerie! Voler en balai, jeter des sorts, combattre les trolls : Harry Potter se révèle un sorcier doué. Mais un mystère entoure sa naissance et l'effroyable V..., le mage dont personne n'ose prononcer le nom. Amitié, surprises, dangers, scènes comiques, Harry découvre ses pouvoirs et la vie à Poudlard. Le premier tome des aventures du jeune héros vous ensorcelle aussitôt!Thème principal composé par James Hannigan
data.name: Harry Potter à L'école des Sorciers

Fast Cars! Magic Mushrooms! Dynamite! Snipers! Ladyboys!This High Speed Rally Race Has It All! Like Fight Club meets Cannonball Run, Chicken 65 is a hilarious collision of chaos and comedy, where laughter and insight run wild. Both rebellion and celebration, this racing tale of men off the map charts new ground!Rich Archer is a laptop nomad wrapping up a year in Thailand. Plans change when his visiting friend stumbles into Chicken 65, a secret road rally race running since the Vietnam War. Leaving Bangkok at dawn, drivers chase a chicken through Southeast Asia. Joining this mysterious brotherhood, the friends are thrown into a sprawling, lawless race for Chicken victory. On twisted roads of dynamite and double-crosses, they learn that winning The Bird might mean losing their mind. Too late to quit, too fast to stop, both men head farther off the map and deeper into Chicken 65.ABOUT THE AUTHORHugh O'Neil Gallagher is the author of the world famous College Application Essay. He has written feature articles for Rolling Stone, Wired, Newsweek, and the Beastie Boy's Grand Royal. Hugh wrote the script for Daft Punk's famous "Da Funk" video with Spike Jonze. When his novel Teeth was published by Simon and Schuster, critics raved:“Finally, the dental masterpiece we’ve all been waiting for.” Gore Vidal“This should be on the top of the MTV Generation’s reading list. Comparable to the novels of Jay McInerney and Bret Easton Ellis…” Library Journal“Gallagher writes with devilish wit and without cynicism… a funny, beautiful debut.”  The Village Voice“A scathingly humorous look at the MTV generation… Gallagher’s writing is a modern art all its own.” New York Post
data.name: Chicken 65: A Madcap Meditation On The Race of Man

data.description:
Author(s): KJ Smith
Narrator(s): Digital Voice Madison G

This audiobook is narrated by a digital voice.A Brief History of House Music steps inside the sweat-drenched, euphoric warehouses of 1980s Chicago to tell the story of the genre that taught the world how to dance—and kept dancing. More than a musical style, house music was a revolution: a defiant, joyful, and deeply inclusive sound born from the ashes of disco, forged by Black and queer DJs using cheap drum machines and a vision of unity on the dance floor. This book traces house music's journey from underground sanctuary to global phenomenon, revealing how a four-on-the-floor kick drum became the heartbeat of modern club culture.The journey begins in Chicago's South Side, where DJ Frankie Knuckles at The Warehouse (from which "house" takes its name) and Ron Hardy at the Muzic Box began blending disco edits, European synth-pop, and stark 808 and 909 drum machine patterns into something entirely new. The narrative follows the first wave of producers—Marshall Jefferson ("Move Your Body"), Larry Heard (Mr. Fingers), and Adonis—who released the first house records and defined the sound: soulful vocals, piano riffs, deep basslines, and a spiritual, hypnotic pulse. The book then traces house's explosion across the Atlantic to the UK, where the Second Summer of Love (1988–89) saw massive illegal raves, the rise of acid house (marked by the squelching TB-303 bassline), and the cultural phenomenon of the smiley face. Later chapters explore house's endless subdivision into deep house, garage, progressive house, French touch (Daft Punk), and its enduring influence on pop, techno, and EDM. Ecstatic, rigorous, and deeply affectionate, A Brief History of House Musiccelebrates a genre that turned a warehouse into a cathedral and a drum machine into a prayer for acceptance and joy.
data.name: A Brief History of House Music

Le pouvoir… on le désire, on le craint, on s’en protège…« Le sentiment de n’avoir aucun pouvoir sur les gens et les événements est difficilement supportable : l’impuissance rend malheureux. Personne ne réclame moins de pouvoir, tout le monde en veut davantage. »Amoral, intelligent, impitoyable et captivant, cet ouvrage colossal condense 3 000 ans d’histoire du pouvoir en 48 lois. Véritable manuel de la manipulation, il analyse la quintessence de cette sagesse millénaire, tirée de la vie des plus illustres stratèges (Sun Zi, Clausewitz), hommes d’État (Louis XIV, Bismarck, Talleyrand), courtisans (Castiglione, Gracián), séducteurs (Ninon de Lenclos, Casanova) et escrocs de l’histoire.Certaines lois reposent sur la prudence (loi n° 1 : Ne surpassez jamais le maître), d’autres demandent de la dissimulation (loi n° 7 : Laissez le travail aux autres, mais recueillez-en les lauriers), d’autres encore une absence totale de compassion (loi n° 15 : Écrasez complètement l’ennemi). Toutes ces lois trouveront des applications dans votre vie de tous les jours… Car, soyez en certain : le monde est une immense cour où se trament toutes sortes d’intrigues.Au lieu de nier l’évidence, tâchez d’exceller dans la course au pouvoir.  Translated By: Myra Bories, Lakshmi Bories
data.name: Power: Les 48 Lois du pouvoir

data.description:
Author(s): Craig Ferguson
Narrator(s): Craig Ferguson

“With American on Purpose, Craig Ferguson somehow manages to avoid the pitfalls of self-indulgence and self-importance that plague most (okay, all) Hollywood autobiographies. He has, instead, written a book that is hilarious and irrepressibly daft, yet also kind, poignant, and undeniably wise. It was a joy to read.”  — Dennis Lehane, New York Times Bestselling author of The Given DayFerguson delivers a moving and achingly funny memoir of living the American dream as he journeys from the mean streets of Glasgow, Scotland, to the comedic promised land of Hollywood. Along the way he stumbles through several attempts to make his mark—as a punk rock musician, a construction worker, a bouncer, and, tragically, a modern dancer. To numb the pain of failure, Ferguson found comfort in drugs and alcohol, addictions that eventually led to an aborted suicide attempt. (He forgot to do it when someone offered him a glass of sherry.) But his story has a happy ending: success on the hit sitcom The Drew Carey Show, and later as the host of CBS's Late Late Show. By far Ferguson's greatest triumph was his decision to become a U.S. citizen, a milestone he achieved in early 2008.In American on Purpose, Craig Ferguson talks a red, white, and blue streak about everything our Founding Fathers feared.
data.name: American on Purpose: An Honest and Hilarious Memoir from Working-Class Glasgow to Hollywood
